evidence.quote: Meld je uiterlijk 1 mei aan via Studielink.

note.fr: Diplôme étranger (Bac marocain) : la page indique que les titulaires d'un diplôme havo/vwo/mbo néerlandais sont admissibles directement ; pour un diplôme étranger, voir la page 'Toelating' / 'aanmelden internationaal'. Admission à vérifier.
note.en: Foreign diploma (Moroccan Bac): the page states holders of a Dutch havo/vwo/mbo diploma are directly admissible; for a foreign diploma see the 'Toelating' / 'aanmelden internationaal' page. Admission must be checked.

evidence.quote: Met een havo-, vwo-, of mbo-diploma (niveau 4) ben je direct toelaatbaar.

notes: Tuition left out: the only fee information is institution-wide and contains no amount (the collegegeld pages state fees depend on nationality and that the instellingscollegegeld amount is set by the College van Bestuur and varies per programme or student group; no non-EU amount for 2026-2027 or later is quoted). Intakes: the programme starts in September and February; only the 6 September 2027 first lesson week is dated. The '1 mei 2027' deadline is not tied to international/non-EU applicants, so it is not entered. The page's own admission requirement ('Met een havo-, vwo-, of mbo-diploma (niveau 4) ben je direct toelaatbaar.') is not applicable to a Moroccan Baccalauréat holder and references a separate international admission page not supplied.
